system_prompt_style.note: The paper does not describe how the system prompt is built. The only repository bundled is karpathy/autoresearch, which inspired MLIPilot but is not MLIPilot's code.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Agents interact through six typed tools: read file, write file, edit file, list files, submit and wait, and finish.
env_context_strategy.note: Coded from the paper only. The Data Inspector parses the dataset metadata, but the paper does not say this is injected into the prompt.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Orchestrates LLM tool-calling with retry logic, context truncation at 80k tokens,
context_compaction.note: The paper does not say which messages are truncated. truncate_oldest is the closest value.

observation_format.note: The paper does not describe the observation format.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: auto-research framework in which tool-calling large language models propose hypotheses, edit MLIP training code, launch HPC jobs

tool_count.evidence_quote: Agents interact through six typed tools: read file, write file, edit file, list files, submit and wait, and finish.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Agents interact through six typed tools: read file, write file, edit file, list files, submit and wait, and finish.
edit_primitive.note: write_file is coded as whole_file_rewrite. The paper does not give the argument format of edit_file, so its primitive is unknown.

tool_schema_source.note: The paper calls the tools 'typed' but does not say where the schema comes from.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only. No dependency list or source code was available to check for protocol clients.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the LLM agent proposes a code change, the system trains a model on an HPC cluster, evaluates the result against the scorecard, and either accepts the improvement or reverts to the previous best.
loop_primitives.note: Algorithm 1 is a tool-calling loop, which gives react. The train, evaluate and accept/revert cycle gives generate_test_repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: submit and wait requires three structured arguments: hypothesis (what should improve), target metric (which metric), and risk (what might degrade)
planning_granularity.note: Hypotheses are attached to each submission, but the paper describes no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.note: The loop has one LLM, M. The 'multi-agent benchmark' in the paper compares separate models run individually, not agents working together.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Agents interact through six typed tools: read file, write file, edit file, list files, submit and wait, and finish.
delegation_mechanism.note: The paper's full tool list contains no delegation tool.

human_in_loop.note: The paper does not discuss human gating.

short_term_state.note: The paper does not describe the state object.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Computes composite score, enforces hard gates, and issues accept/reject decisions with automatic workspace revert on rejection.
self_verification.note: The harness runs training and physical evaluation, and the scorecard result is fed back to the agent.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Each received budget B=10 (up to ten train-and-evaluate iterations)
retry_policy.note: Attempts are capped by an iteration budget. Plateau early stopping also exists. LLM retry logic is at the transport level.

rollback.evidence_quote: the candidate is rejected and the workspace reverts to the previous best configuration.
rollback.note: Algorithm 1 uses Snapshot()/Revert(). The mechanism (git or copies) is not stated.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This cycle repeats until the iteration budget is exhausted or the agent converges.
termination_condition.note: There is a finish tool. Sec. 4.4 reports '3 consecutive rejections triggered early stopping'.

cost_controls.note: The iteration budget is the only budget reported. No token or cost cap is reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: an agentic framework coupling tool-calling LLMs with Slurm HPC execution
execution_isolation.note: Training jobs are launched on a Slurm HPC cluster; the isolation of the agent's own code edits is not described. Closest value is remote.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Only train.py above the harness sentinel is writable.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Only train.py above the harness sentinel is writable.
permission_model.note: The write scope is fixed, and SHA-256 integrity checks run before each submission. No human or risk-engine approval is described.

tracing.evidence_quote: enforcing scientific discipline and producing auditable experiment records.

eval_hooks.note: The scorecard evaluator is the task objective, not a benchmark hook. No repository was available to check.

guardrails.evidence_quote: SHA-256 hashes of the evaluation harness and scorecard are computed at initialization and verified before every submission.

target_domain.evidence_quote: LLM-Driven Auto-Research for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
target_domain.note: The domain is scientific ML (MLIP training).

open_source.note: No MLIPilot repository or licence is given. The bundled repo is karpathy/autoresearch, whose README states MIT, but it is only the inspiration.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Mistral-24B (self-hosted via vLLM on H100), and Qwen3-32B (self-hosted via vLLM on H100)
model_agnostic.note: The paper evaluates OpenAI models alongside self-hosted open-weight models.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: MLIPilot: LLM-Driven Auto-Research for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
primary_artifact.note: No MLIPilot code was available. The linked repo is karpathy/autoresearch.

first_release_date.note: This is the paper v1 date, used as a fallback because no repository or tag is available.

pinned_version.note: The bundled pin (karpathy/autoresearch master 228791fb499a) is a different system and is not MLIPilot.

stars.note: The 96348 stars belong to karpathy/autoresearch, not MLIPilot.
